title: Implement sqlite-vec vector search + Embedder seam + hybrid ranking
description:
**Files:** `src/store/embed.rs` (new: `Embedder` trait — model id, dim 384, batch embed; `StubEmbedder` kept solely as an internal unit-test seam), `src/store/vector.rs` (new: vec0 k-NN + cosine scores), `src/store/query.rs` (hybrid merge via reciprocal-rank fusion, deterministic), `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `08_vector_search.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** per the maintainer's decision (BOTSPY-bb60bb closed): `08_vector_search.feature` exercises the REAL all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedder — the deterministic stub is never the shipped embedder and never drives vector/semantic search specs (internal unit tests only). The embedder is a store-open concern (no embedder configured → semantic queries return a clean empty result, text queries unaffected); meta model id set on first embed, a mismatched model refused with a clean error; hybrid merge of FTS + k-NN results via reciprocal-rank fusion, composable with filters, one ranked result type for both paths; engine invisible.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Done: sqlite-vec vector search — sessions/messages/parts embedded at ingest behind the Embedder seam, semantic k-NN with a 0.3 cosine relevance floor, hybrid ranking fusing text RRF with cosine; 08_vector_search.feature green. Also fixed the real-embedder quality bug: the Xenova tokenizer pads to a fixed 128 tokens, so pooling must weight by the attention mask, not the id count. Committed to feat/local-store (39094e1, PR #4).
